thread:
Amanda (AE): Heads up — ClearWave renewal next month. Usage spiked ~3x, they want to rebaseline and expand commit from 2k -> 7k tokens/day equivalent. Asking for a 30% uplift discount on the new commit. Need deal-desk approval + presales to confirm POC pricing and any security blockers. Sheet: https://redwood.atlassian.net/clearwave-renewal
Raj (Solutions Eng): Quick q — are they staying on same model family? any long sequences or high embedding volume? That changes node config.
Leo (CSM): they said mostly chat loads, avg seq length ~512, some rare 2k seqs. Also asked for EU region for latency.
Marta (Security): Security note — EU data residency question still open from their compliance team. SSO & SOC2 are fine. Raising the data residency workstream now.
SecurityBot: SecurityBot: questionnaire submitted (SEC-2026-483). SOC2: yes. SSO: configured. Pending: data residency / VPC endpoints.
Raj (Solutions Eng): For POC we recommended 4x A100 equiv, KV cache enabled, quantized model. Rough hosted run-rate ~ $18k/mo, with a 7k/day committed discount it drops to ~ $11k/mo.
Chris (Finance): Important: floor price for hosted text generation is $0.008/token. Any net price below that needs finance exec sign-off. Also, commit term matters (6 vs 12 mo).
Julia (Deal Desk): Need margin calc. If 30% off on a 7k/day commit for 12 months, what's net ARR and margin? Amanda, paste numbers in the deal-desk template and mark as "Renewal Uplift".
Amanda (AE): Done — sheet filled: https://redwood.atlassian.net/clearwave-renewal#sheet. Quick summary: list price with 7k commit = $132k/year, 30% off -> $92.4k/year, delta vs current = +$58k.
Marta (Security): EU residency likely requires dedicated VPC endpoints or dedicated subnet — ops estimate +$2k/mo. That changes economics.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Quick calc snippet:
```
# rough monthly numbers
list_run_rate = 18000  # hosted run-rate without commit
committed_run_rate = 11000  # with 7k/day commit
discount = 0.30
net_committed = committed_run_rate * (1 - discount)  # -> ~7700
```
With 30% the net ~7.7k/mo; add VPC fee +2k -> ~9.7k/mo.
Chris (Finance): If we must add $2k/mo for VPC, we can approve 25% discount instead of 30% to keep margin. Also prefer 6-month bridge if they want to sign quickly.
Julia (Deal Desk): OK — Julia: marking request as "escalation required" for executive pricing: propose option A = 25% + $2k/mo VPC fee, 6mo commit; option B = 20% + 12mo commit + VPC included. Need CRO or VP Sales sign-off to go to customer.
Amanda (AE): Customer is willing to do a 6mo bridge if we can fast-track EU capacity. They want a firm number by EOD Friday.
Leo (CSM): I can push on delivery timeline for EU; estimate 7 business days for dedicated endpoints if infra approves.
Marta (Security): Legal will need to sign the addendum for data residency. That might add 2-3 days.
Raj (Solutions Eng): Technical ask: can we offer a temporary EU proxy (cached nodes) to meet latency while we provision VPC? If yes, we can meet customer mid-term.
Chris (Finance): If we present Option A (25% + $2k fee) it's finance-preferred. Amanda, flag this for final pricing in the template and we'll fast-track to Julia.
Julia (Deal Desk): Done — updated template with Option A/B. Tagging for approval: @CRO @VP_Sales. If no exec reply by EOD, we'll propose Option A to the customer.
Amanda (AE): @CRO - please weigh in. Customer can sign by EOD Friday if we lock Option A. I'll draft the email.
SecurityBot: SecurityBot: Ticket SEC-2026-483 updated — data residency addendum sent to Legal. ETA: 48-72h.
Amanda (AE): Thanks team — I'll push Option A to the customer with the caveat of VPC fee and 6mo term. Will update here after call.
Julia (Deal Desk): Noted. If CRO approves before EOD, I'll mark deal as pre-approved. :thumbsup:
Chris (Finance): Fine from finance assuming VPC fee passes to customer. :ok_hand:
Marta (Security): Will follow up with Legal on the addendum timeline.
Leo (CSM): I'll prep the EU pilot plan and customer comms.
Amanda (AE): Thanks — closing loop once I have the signature
__notes: thread is a single continuous string with messages prefixed by sender names, contains presales/pricing/renewal uplift coordination and deal-desk escalation
